title: 5 AI Tools Traders & Creators Actually Use in 2025

slides.headline: Slide 1 — The Hook
slides.body: Most people are drowning in AI tools. Few know which ones print money. Here are the 5 I use every single day.

slides.headline: Slide 2 — ChatGPT (o1 / GPT-4.5)
slides.body: My second brain. I use it to draft hooks, analyze earnings reports, and stress-test trade setups at 3am. If you're not using custom GPTs yet, you're leaving hours on the table.

slides.headline: Slide 3 — Claude 3.5 Sonnet
slides.body: Better writer than ChatGPT. Sharper at long-form. I feed it my raw voice notes and it turns them into captions, emails, and scripts that actually sound like me.

slides.headline: Slide 4 — TradingView + AI Alerts
slides.body: Charts, backtests, and AI pattern detection in one place. Set alerts. Walk away. Come back when the setup triggers. Stop staring at screens like it's 2015.

slides.headline: Slide 5 — ElevenLabs + HeyGen
slides.body: Clone your voice. Clone your face. Post in 5 languages while you sleep. Creators who ignore this will get buried by the ones who don't.

slides.headline: Slide 6 — Perplexity
slides.body: Research that used to take 2 hours now takes 4 minutes. Live market data, cited sources, zero hallucinations. Google is done. This is what replaces it.

cta: Grab 'AI for Traders & Creators' — link in bio. The full playbook, none of the fluff.
